messages:
marta: Hey team, running through the onboarding sampleapp and hit a weird mismatch on embeddings + rerank. Node SDK returns a different top-level key and occasionally extra padding vectors after an auth-retry.

marta: Repro steps: start sampleapp, send batch of 6 inputs to /v1/embeddings (model=redwood-embed-compact), trigger token-refresh by expiring test token. Observed response printed by sampleapp: 
```json
{"vectors": [ [0.01, 0.02, ...], [ ... ], ... ], "meta": {"dim": 1024} }
```

marta: Notice: key `vectors` vs expected `embeddings`, and for some retries the SDK returns 7 vectors for 6 inputs (trailing all-zero vector).

raj: thanks. Which SDK version? headers?

marta: node-sdk 0.8.5, python-sdk 0.9.2. Auth header was Authorization: Bearer test-expired-token; client attempts refresh and retries.

olivia: sounds like two separate bugs: A) response-key parity between SDKs (vectors vs embeddings) B) retry flow mutating batch and adding padding. Is the padding coming from batch helper or from server?

sam: I instrumented the helper. It does this on retry: 
```js
// pseudo
if (shouldRetry) {
  batch.push(zeroVec) // oops mutating original
  send(batch)
}
```

sam: so it's client-side. The retry branch constructs a padded batch instead of reusing an immutable snapshot.

raj: ok. Short-term: add a normalize step in sampleapp: 
```js
const raw = res.embeddings || res.vectors || []
const trimmed = raw.slice(0, inputs.length)
```

olivia: long-term fix: 1) node SDK: normalize `vectors`->`embeddings` in the response layer; 2) change batch helper to clone batch on retry (Array.from or spread) and never mutate original; 3) add unit test that simulates 401+refresh, assert output length matches input length.

marta: I pushed quick workaround to sampleapp tests so onboarding CI doesn't flake: https://git.redwood.ai/sampleapp/pull/245 (adds adapter + assertion).

ci-bot: sampleapp CI: failed test set "embed-onboard" -> failing due to padding (flaky).

devex-bot: Created DEVEX-4999: "node-sdk: embeddings key mismatch & retry padding causing extra vector" (assignee: olivia).

olivia: I'll pick up DEVEX-4999. Plan: make response normalizer in client, patch batch helper retry to use snapshot, add e2e test with token-refresh simulation, and cut a patch release 0.8.6.

raj: also worth logging a metric when response length !== request length + model name so we can alert and find server-side regressions.

sam: agree. I'll add a short-lived alert: devex.embed.mismatch.count > 0 on staging.

marta: thanks all. leaving this thread so folks can copy the temp fix if they hit onboarding weirdness. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: DEVEX-4999 status: triaged (olivia)
